query:
SELECT c.id, count(a.pid) AS "n!"
             FROM programme.proposal_comments c
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL unnest($2::uuid[]) AS a(pid)
                    ON a.pid <> c.author_id
                   AND programme.comment_in_committee_circle(c.id, a.pid)
            WHERE c.id = ANY($1)
            GROUP BY c.id
